title: Premium Pet Snacks
question: Can premium pet snacks be a durable business at 20 hrs a week and S$5k to S$20k, and does any version beat Club and Coach Desk?
decision_text: Park premium pet snacks with no ranked slot. Run one capped no-spend test by 21 Oct (about 3.5 Chairman hours). Gate on 23 Oct: both tests pass, then a reserve only; otherwise drop. Licensing is AVS, not SFA.
footer: Estimates are labelled as such. No robot found willingness-to-pay data for pet snacks; this is a park-and-test decision, not a launch.

r1: Each robot listed 10 versions of the idea from an assigned lens: pain points, licensing, unit economics, channels and evidence. Unedited.
r2: LEDGER, COGSWORTH, PROBE and BEACON attacked the strongest versions and compared them with Club and Coach Desk. Unedited.
